<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Stance:</strong> The RBI Monetary Policy Committee kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with a neutral stance, as members expressed a cautious outlook on inflation risks stemming from volatile food and fuel prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNSFZ1eUluSlJfdjZsTVA4eVhXejh5a1BuaDYwTFF5NHNUUTFWczdUanAzMzJIZDdsRWYzQk5lVHg2VVhremtiVFd3Wkd4X1dBQTFxamNyckhCTjN1aEh5U3djUVBLUWxsa3pxbkd3WFZyUmVSVFpXWERBQk5LVkp5elBsQm9vei14bkU0eTBWSHludGFkM0I1cGJHZ0hmcmJCV0xFRUxwbDI3OXVVUHpR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPbmhkYTh2VWFBdUNVMnRoZWhxbTdFcGRqMEd0bXE0cGpidkNJV0RmbzNlX0JEaFNMbm1LajRTZmpiNEJ0ZUJtdDZVaGZRXzlHNFRiT0dKTXJPdENhdHZoT193Yld0eVltSjlabkpiS0FVSXA1dXpmUzh4azJmT1FNcVVTUndtb0M5UFdjREZPbU53cVlEOUY5Z2wzNU9NTE02cm1hNHZfZ0ZyNkFoNVZBdnFVdENVLWxfWFlBdUZNSm4weGNQTUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> Indian benchmark indices extended their losing streak to seven consecutive sessions, with the Sensex falling 326 points and the Nifty closing below 24,100, pressured by rising crude oil prices and regional instability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency Pressure:</strong> The Indian rupee hit a three-week low, trading near 95.76 against the USD, as traders remain wary of further depreciation toward the 96 level amid sustained pressure from oil prices and West Asian tensions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1uMVJmTXo4XzE4WWhydnN2N0d1TEpIbzI4Q2FsRUNzWFZQcU5yRmwzeU9nOERsNF9tUUE5dFZHTXNzYnR6US1XbkhEU3RJenFLOS1BMC1B0gFWQVVfeXFMTW4xUmZNejhfMThZaHJ2c3Y3R3VMSkhvMjhDYWxFQ3NYVlBxTnJGbDN5T2c4RGw0X21RQTl0VkdNc3NidHpRLVduSERTdEl6cUs5LUEwLUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
</ul>
